question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the given phrase.

She was on cloud _______ after receiving the scholarship.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**on cloud nine**" is a commonly used idiom that means extremely happy or elated.
 
• In the given sentence, "She was on cloud _______ after receiving the scholarship," the correct word is "nine" as it completes the idiom appropriately.
 
• The other options: "**ten**," "**seven**," and "**eight**" do not fit the idiom correctly.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *She was on cloud nine__ after receiving the scholarship.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **On cloud ten**: Not a commonly used idiom.
 
• **On cloud seven**: Incorrect as "cloud seven" is not part of the idiom.
 
• **On cloud eight**: Incorrect as "cloud eight" is not part of the idiom.
